notes: REF-BM-03: metadata is edited only after save via the detail panel; the add form takes only a URL, no pre-save edit of the auto-collected title/description. REF-BM-04: PATCH/update handles title/description/notes/tags/status but never the url/address, so url editing is missing. REF-BM-08: clicking a list card opens the edit panel, not the original url; the url is only reachable via a link inside the panel, not by selecting the item. REF-BM-10: edit-tags is a plain comma-separated text input with no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-14: `#tag` syntax not parsed; q is a literal substring, tag names stored without '#' so it cannot match. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing; query is a single LIKE substring. REF-BM-16: no quote handling; quotes are matched literally, no distinct exact-phrase query language. REF-BM-20: no multi-select UI or bulk endpoints. REF-BM-21: no bulk-on-filter capability. REF-BM-23: markdown notes can be stored but are only shown in a textarea, never rendered as markdown when viewing. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundle table/endpoint/UI to save search+tag filters. REF-BM-30: importer parses title and tags but ignores ADD_DATE, so date-added is not preserved (created_at set to now). REF-BM-32: no user-settings UI/persistence (default sort, displayed items, font size); sort control is transient and not stored.
